title: Shield
summary: A kite shield asset focused on wear patterns, layered materials, and broad reads that hold up in a game-facing presentation context.

seo.title: Shield asset
seo.description: Shield asset study centered on broad readability and surface wear.

caseStudy.hook: A broad-read asset where material wear had to support the silhouette instead of replacing it.
brief: The shield is a useful reference for controlled aging and shape clarity.

sections.title: Surface storytelling
body: Damage, paint wear, and roughness variation were treated as structure, not decoration.

outcomes: A more reliable wear-language reference for prop production
